style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal #1B1B1D sections and panel-white #F4F5F6 sections, with brushed-silver #C9CCD0 metal panels for infographic blocks

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1B1D, panel white #F4F5F6, brushed silver #C9CCD0 and one signal-red accent #D6302E; neutral-cool directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent filled rounded red icons, thin red divider bars and red numbered circles; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins on light panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; structure annotations use small round accent dots with thin leader lines; no floating product, contact shadow always present
style.surfaceSystem: brushed steel plate, light marble floor, matte jobsite workbench surfaces
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; headline fills are brushed-metal #C9CCD0 on dark sections and charcoal #2D2D2D on light sections
